architecture.scope: Python-hosted language and scientific workbench with a separately bounded C11 native compiler slice.
architecture.runtime_boundary: Host Python runtime; native compiler slice is independently built and tested.
architecture.composition_rule: Compose language, science, voxel and IDE capabilities through owned package interfaces; do not pull the Python runtime into freestanding targets.

components.responsibility: Lexer, parser, AST, scopes and semantic checks.
SI quantities, dimensional analysis and reproducible sampling.
Sparse spatial structures and Morton indexing.
Typed C11 IR and platform boundary; not a complete native compiler.
CLI, IDE, test runner and developer workflows.

preserved_boundaries: Native compiler slice has its own ABI and build profile.
Scientific dimensions and spatial indexing remain separate domain modules.
forbidden_composition: Do not link Python runtime into freestanding kernel targets.
Do not equate module metadata with binary/runtime dependency.
Do not label the native compiler slice as a complete compiler.
gaps: Run and record Python and native test suites on supported hosts.
Complete compiler feature and target-qualification evidence before raising maturity.
